We're reviewing the AMD RX 9070 GRE (Golden Rabbit Edition) GPU that launched in China last year. These benchmarks look at the RX 9070 GRE, 9070, and 9070 XT vs. the NVIDIA RTX 5070, 5070 Ti, 5060 Ti, 5080, and a total of around 30 GPUs (plus or minus), so the dataset should give you plenty to work with for determining the best video cards in 2026 to be accompanied by RAM that no one can afford to buy. Our focus is more on the Yeston Sakura design for the RX 9070 GRE, looking at thermals, acoustic, and power.
